title: HLSE URL Verdict
description: JSON output of `hlse_core --json <url>`. Fields marked required are always present; all others are conditional on score band or available signals.

hlse_version.description: HLSE engine version that produced this verdict. Use this field to identify verdicts that predate a new detector capability and should be re-scanned.

action.description: Human-readable band for the score. Prefer `severity` for numeric routing.

severity.description: Monotonic CVSS-aligned band integer: 0=SAFE 1=LOG 2=ALERT 3=BLOCK 4=ISOLATE. Use `severity >= 3` for 'actionable' gates — stable against future tier insertions.

signal_count.description: Number of independent detector families that fired. Present when score > 0.

confidence.description: Qualitative label for signal corroboration (e.g. 'corroborated by 3 independent signals'). Present when score > 0.

canonical_brand.description: Brand name when the URL was positively confirmed as a canonical domain (score 0 only).

blind_spot.description: What HLSE cannot detect — present when score 0, to prevent mistaking OK for proof of safety.

pattern.description: Human-readable attack-pattern label (e.g. 'typosquat credential-harvest page'). Present when score > 0 and a recognisable pattern was found. May be refined across versions; use pattern_id for stable routing.

pattern_id.description: Stable append-only SIEM/SOAR routing token. Present iff `pattern` is present. Never changes meaning once issued.

objective.description: The attacker's likely objective and asset at risk (score >= 60 only).

confusable.description: First disguised non-ASCII character in the host, with Unicode codepoint. Present when a non-ASCII homoglyph is detected.

ascii_diff.description: ASCII lookalike substitution summary (e.g. char 6 is digit '1', masking letter 'l'). Present for typosquat/ASCII homoglyph verdicts.

safe_url.description: The canonical brand URL to use instead (score >= 60 only, when a brand domain is identifiable).

verify.description: The single best independent check to confirm this verdict without trusting HLSE (score >= 40 — ALERT band and above; co-occurs with exoneration in the 40-59 overlap).

triage.description: 60-second post-click response to minimise damage (score >= 60 only).

cascade_risk.description: Other accounts and assets at risk beyond the primary target (score >= 60 only).

exoneration.description: Benign explanation and falsifying test for borderline scores (score 15–59 only).

channel_delta.description: Score adjustment applied by the channel prior. Present when --from-channel was specified.

effective_score.description: score + channel_delta (capped at 100). Present when --from-channel was specified.

effective_action.description: action band for effective_score. Present when --from-channel was specified.

effective_severity.description: severity for effective_score. Present when --from-channel was specified.

channel_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of the channel prior adjustment. Present when --from-channel was specified and a reason exists.

reasons.description: Per-signal detector reasons. Empty array for SAFE verdicts.
